notes: Company background: B2B marketplace search + catalog personalization for SMB merchants.
Primary objective: improve SERP relevance using reranking layer rather than replacing search infra.
POC asks: 1) reranking endpoint with candidate scoring, 2) offline batch scorer to run on eval sets, 3) clear token-cost delta between hosted and dedicated.
Latency/throughput targets: 95p < 120ms for rerank per query when candidate set <= 50; peak throughput ~120 qps during business hours.
Quality targets: +8–12% NDCG@10 on internal eval set or equivalent CTR lift in 2-week A/B.
Model prefs: open LLM variants allowed (Llama-family fine-tuned), prefer quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce cost.
Routing/fallback: need fallback to cheap lexical ranker when load spikes; desire auto-routing by SLO/cost tier.
Data/PRIVACY: cannot send user PII to third-party endpoints; POC will scrub PII and use synthetic/resampled eval sets.
Security: procurement flagged KMS + audit logs; asked for SOC2 + ISO summary and data residency notes.
